title: Countable C¹ bi-Lipschitz chart cover of a countably n-rectifiable set (Simon Ch. 3, Lemma 1.2 and Remark 1.3)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let M ⊆ ℝ^P (ℝᵏ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) be countably n-rectifiable in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.1 (SimonGMT `CountablyRectifiable n M`: there are M₀ ⊆ ℝ^P with Hⁿ(M₀) = 0 and Lipschitz maps F_j : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P, j ∈ ℕ, with M ⊆ M₀ ∪ ⋃_j F_j(ℝⁿ); Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Then there are maps Φ_j : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P of class C¹ and open sets Ω_j ⊆ ℝⁿ (j ∈ ℕ) such that each Φ_j is Lipschitz on Ω_j (with some constant K_j ≥ 0), each Φ_j is antilipschitz on Ω_j (there is c_j > 0 with c_j|w − w′| ≤ |Φ_j(w) − Φ_j(w′)| for all w, w′ ∈ Ω_j), and Hⁿ(M ∖ ⋃_j Φ_j(Ω_j)) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)), CountablyRectifiable n M → ∃ (Φ : ℕ → Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : ℕ → Set (Eucl n)), (∀ j, IsOpen (Ω j)) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Φ j)) ∧ (∀ j, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K (Φ j) (Ω j)) ∧ (∀ j, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω j, ∀ w' ∈ Ω j, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ j w - Φ j w'‖) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (M \ ⋃ j, Φ j '' Ω j) = 0
